181    /**
182     * Randomly return a danish CPR number (Personnal identification number) format.
183     *
184     * @see http://cpr.dk/cpr/site.aspx?p=16
185     * @see http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Personal_identification_number_%28Denmark%29
186     *
187     * @return string
188     */
189    public static function cpr()
190    {
191        $birthdate = DateTime::dateTimeThisCentury();
192
193        return sprintf('%s-%s', $birthdate->format('dmy'), static::numerify('%###'));
194    }
